hint.text: To estimate the length of something means to guess how long you think it is by looking at it or comparing it to other objects.

instruction.text: How long is the banana? Estimate the length in stamps.

atoms.b: The banana is about as long as ((1 2 3 ++4 5)) stamps.
atoms.finishSound: The banana is about as long as four stamps.

instruction.text: How long is the box of eggs?  Estimate the length in stamps.

atoms.b: The box of eggs is about as long as ((1 2 ++3 4 5)) stamps.
atoms.finishSound: The box of eggs is about as long as three stamps.

instruction.text: How long is the rubber? Estimate the length in stamps.

atoms.b: The rubber is about as long as ((++1 2 3 4 5)) stamp.
atoms.finishSound: The rubber is about as long as one stamp.

instruction.text: How long is the calculator? Estimate the length in stamps.

atoms.b: The calculator is about as long as ((1 2 ++3 4 5)) stamps.
atoms.finishSound: The calculator is about as long as three stamps.

instruction.text: How long are the glasses? Estimate the length in stamps.

atoms.b: The glasses are about as long as ((1 ++2 3 4 5)) stamps.
atoms.finishSound: The glasses are about as long as two stamps.
